rows.note: Use this all-purpose everyday choice when the emphasis is that something is temporary or interim.

example.english: This arrangement is only transitional; we'll change it once the new system is implemented.
example.traditional: 呢個安排只係臨時，等新制度落實先再改。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 zi2 hai6 lam4 si4 dang2 san1 zai3 dou6 lok6 sat6 sin1 zoi3 goi2

rows.note: Use this for a formal or technical description relating to a transition, especially when the temporary arrangement leads to a new system.

example.english: This transitional arrangement will remain until the new system is formally implemented.
example.traditional: 呢個過渡性安排會維持到新制度正式推行。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwo3 dou6 sing3 on1 paai4 wui5 wai4 ci4 dou3 san1 zai3 dou6 zing3 sik1 teoi1 hang4
